dogecoin.text: Dogecoin down nearly 30 percent during Elon Musk's 'SNL' appearance https://t.co/pvt8iHEtlD

Either Dogecoin is solar-powered or Musk is lying.

In 2018 the SEC sanctioned him over ‘misleading tweets’ that moved the market in his favor: ‘Tesla’s board will adopt important reforms —including an obligation to oversee Musk’s communications with investors.’

SpaceX, however, will accept Dogecoin, Elon’s favored cryptocurrency, which makes you wonder if this is an attempted dump to pump Doge. Bitcoin is already down, apparently as a result of this announcement, as if Americans were buying Teslas with bitcoin en masse.
